name: Methodology improvement
about: Suggest a change to the protocol, rubric, data design, or reproducibility plan
title: "Methodology: "
labels: methodology
assignees: ""
---

## Current limitation

Identify the exact file, section, or procedure that needs improvement.

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest change that addresses the limitation.

## Methodological effect

How would this affect construct validity, condition isolation, annotation, dependence, missingness, or reproducibility?

## Comparability impact

Would existing pilot or future main-run records require re-generation or re-annotation?

## Privacy and scope check

- [ ] Uses synthetic, non-identifiable, non-clinical material only
- [ ] Contains no real reflection or personal data
- [ ] Contains no private product code, prompt, configuration, screenshot, or roadmap
- [ ] Makes no unsupported claim of results, approval, funding, or endorsement

## Verification

List tests, reviews, or sensitivity checks that would show the change works as intended.
